author: Kairolan
quote: Thirteen years in the oven and they served us raw dough. The map is huge and empty, half the missions feel like glorified fetch quests with extra driving, and the shooting still feels stiff as a board. Jason and Lucia try way too hard to be edgy, and the whole thing collapses under its own bloated hype. Save your money and replay something that actually respects your time. Graphics pretty though.

author: Kairolan
quote: The original game changed my life completely when it comes to video games. It was always a very special game to me. The first play through was for that younger version of me. All for the fun of the game and feel for the story. The second play through is where I doubled down to actual gameplay features, replay ability, and just reviewing the game as whole. Nostalgia aside, I completed everything I could. Even the tedious golden skulltullas. After everything, I can easily say that I have no complaints about this game. It’s almost near master piece when it comes to remakes. The game is a little easier compared to the original because of some quality of life features and small changes within game. However it feel this can be overlooked in my eyes because ocarina wasn’t really known for its difficulty in the first place. I would say after this remake and with the possible master quest later on to be released, this is the most optimal way to experience ocarina of time for new and old players. Here’s to hoping we can get a MM remake in the future to finish off the hero of times story.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
